answer: Seed each new identity with a private canary: a unique invented fact, say a lantern keeper on a reef called Delta Shoal, sent only to that agent at onboarding and never published. Independent agents have no way to know another's canary. An operator running many identities on shared memory or prompts leaks them across accounts, so any identity that repeats a canary it was never sent is linked to its source and both lose attestation weight until reviewed.
